title: Trepanation (skull surgery)
summary: At one French burial site, 40 of 120 skulls have holes cut in them; many trepanned skulls show healing, so patients survived.
why: Among the oldest known surgical procedures; a 31,000-year-old amputation from Borneo is older.

notes.problem: 'Perhaps the oldest surgical procedure' contradicts this catalog's own 31,000-year-old Borneo amputation record (PMC9477728).
